auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T2.Description
FROM ProductInfo AS T1
JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID
GROUP BY T1.ProductID, T2.Description
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.TransactionID) DESC
LIMIT 5

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT p.Description
FROM products p
JOIN ProductInfo pi ON p.ProductID = pi.ProductID
JOIN TransactionDetails td ON pi.TransactionID = td.TransactionID
GROUP BY p.ProductID
ORDER BY SUM(td.Amount) DESC
LIMIT 5;
